run.mode: server mode (node:sqlite), no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, no RESEND_API_KEY
notReached: A4 in full (KPI/folder/manifest effects of deletion, multi-delete, re-import of a deleted file)
A5 entirely (Review all queue, review-sheet CSV round trip)
B2 mostly (versions, Compare, revert, two-tab editing through the UI)
B4 mostly (revoke, 14-day expiry, token tampering, two recipients, resend)
B6 entirely (withdraw a share, correct before/after signature, audit of corrections)
B7 entirely (multi-party and sequential signing vs DESIGN-multi-signature.md)
C1 remainder (session expiry, back/forward, empty states, server stopped mid-save, 1200-contract scale)
C2 time triggers entirely (expiry boundaries, 90/60/30 reminders, evergreen, expiry inside an amendment)
375px layout pass (blocked: egress policy denies the Tailwind CDN)
AI-key pass (no key available; all AI paths tested are the heuristic fallback)
verifiedSound: Server-side role enforcement: 30 of 31 mutating-route probes correctly 403 as Viewer/Legal
Optimistic locking: concurrent saves from the same baseVersion produce 409 and preserve the first write
Contract families: linking a child leaves the parent's seal, frozen copy, versions and audit bit-identical; effectiveExpiry and familyCounts are correct
Filter and search counts: header total exactly matches rows returned in every combination tried
Search punctuation (quotes, backslash, --) neither breaks the query nor leaks an error
The signing completeness gate holds (unlike the share path)

Word files (.doc and .docx) refused by byte sniffing; files over 4 MB refused
Manifest CSV: alternative headers, BOM, CRLF, quoted commas, doubled quotes all parse correctly
Static mode boots and every view renders with zero page errors

fixGroups.title: OTP disclosure
fixGroups.note: Do first. Cheapest S1 in the report.

fixGroups.title: Contract save and delete handlers
fixGroups.note: F-012 and F-013 are safe one-liners. F-014/F-015 change what saves are allowed — human watching; re-run versioning and sealing regressions including the hashMode compatibility path.

fixGroups.title: Share path and portal
fixGroups.note: Entirely inside sealing and the unauthenticated portal. F-021's one-line ensureFull fix is nearly free and stops live data destruction — do it immediately.

fixGroups.title: HTML escaping sweep
fixGroups.note: Mechanical, but land after group 3 to avoid conflicting edits in portal.js.

fixGroups.title: Migration parsing and dedupe
fixGroups.note: F-005 changes the parent-child link suggestions — re-run A7 after it, and re-measure against test-fixtures/batch-01..10.pdf.

fixGroups.title: PDF text extraction
fixGroups.note: Testable headlessly against test-fixtures/gdocs-skia-*.pdf. Any re-extraction pass over existing records must never rewrite a signed contract's frozen body.

fixGroups.title: Validation and accounts
fixGroups.note: F-024's full invitation flow should be scheduled, not squeezed in; the must_change_password interim is half a day.

fixGroups.title: Batch durability
fixGroups.note: Additive; do the banner-only version first.

findings.title: Workspace setup accepts a malformed email and whitespace-only organisation/admin names, on the server as well as in the browser
symptoms: email format never validated at setup or invite
org/name/email never trimmed
the submit control is a button, so type=email never fires
a workspace created with a bad admin address has no recovery path

findings.title: Manifest dates assume dd/mm/yyyy with no validation, so a US-format date becomes an impossible date and is stored silently
symptoms: 01/03/2024 guessed as 1 March with no prompt
an unparseable expiry makes the contract invisible to reminders, Calendar and expiring-soon

findings.title: Manifest values in Kenyan notation parse to nonsense — KES 2.5m becomes 2.5, Kshs. 750,000/- becomes 0
symptoms: multiplier suffixes ignored
a trailing /- yields NaN then 0
portfolio value KPIs and folder totals wrong by orders of magnitude
value-threshold approval rules can never match

findings.title: A rejected manifest leaves the previous one loaded and the banner still names the old file
symptoms: error is a transient toast
the next batch reconciles against the wrong manifest with no signal

findings.title: The near-duplicate threshold flags unrelated contracts as closely related, so half a clean batch stalls waiting for a human decision
symptoms: 5 of 10 unrelated contracts parked at Hamming distance 11-12
24 of 25 in another batch
the default offered action links an unrelated contract as an amendment
parked rows are session-only and vanish on navigation

findings.title: A zero-byte file and a corrupt PDF are both imported as executed contracts of record
symptoms: status Signed on a 0-byte file
counted in the register, folder counts and signed stat
the picker and the drop zone apply different rules

findings.title: The batch summary claims documents were read by OCR when OCR never ran, and the actual OCR error is discarded
symptoms: ocrDocs incremented unconditionally
ocr.error never read
a fixable configuration problem is reported as an unreadable document

findings.title: PDFs using the standard base-14 fonts lose word spaces because the fallback character-width table is wrong; the expiry date and payment terms are silently not extracted
symptoms: 2024BETWEEN, wishesto, itis, willingto
PACKAGING   SUPPLY phantom gaps
expiryDate, paymentTerms and governingLaw all lost
identical fixture with /Widths extracts perfectly, isolating the cause

findings.title: The same file twice in one batch reports 'identical to null — skipped' and the second copy is discarded while the first is still awaiting a decision
symptoms: the reservation placeholder reaches the user as the literal string null
skipping the parked row loses both copies with no record

findings.title: Closing the tab or refreshing during a batch loses every unfinished and every parked file, with nothing anywhere to say it happened
symptoms: 7 of 10 files lost on tab close, 12 of 12 on refresh
no banner, no named files, no record
the loaded manifest is lost too, so reconciliation cannot catch the shortfall

findings.title: A cancelled batch reports itself as finished at 100%
symptoms: cancelled rows counted as done
header reads 'finished' and the bar fills after abandoning 70% of the batch

findings.title: Register search does not escape SQL LIKE wildcards, so searching for % returns the entire portfolio
symptoms: q=% and q=_ each return all 46 rows
q=50% returns 'Rebate 5000 units flat'
q=Supply_Agreement returns 'SupplyXAgreement'
no error and no signal that the result set is wrong

findings.title: POST /api/ai/allowance/document is the one mutating route with no role guard
symptoms: a Viewer gets 200 and decrements the onboarding allowance counter

findings.title: A signed, sealed contract can be rewritten wholesale through the API — text, frozen copy, value and audit trail — because the server never checks execution state
symptoms: a Legal user rewrote body, execution.html, value and audit on a signed contract, 200 OK
the entire seal computation is client-side so a self-consistent forgery verifies green
audit accepted from the client verbatim

findings.title: A signed contract can be deleted outright by any Legal user through the API; the interface guard is not enforced on the server
symptoms: DELETE returns 200 on an executed contract, GET then 404
no tombstone, no audit, no admin notice
orphans the file row and the share rows

findings.title: Deleting a contract orphans its uploaded file; the bytes stay in the database with nothing pointing at them
symptoms: files rows never deleted
GET /api/files/:id serves any id to any signed-in user including a Viewer
the delete dialog claims the removal is permanent and total

findings.title: Deleting a contract leaves its share links live, and the portal keeps serving the contract to anyone holding one
symptoms: contract is 404 from the API while the share link still renders the document
still offers Approve & sign, Request changes and Decline
the owner has no way to see this

findings.title: The counterparty's signing one-time code is printed on the counterparty's own screen whenever email is not configured
findings.blastRadius: contained but on the signing path
symptoms: anyone with the link can sign as anyone
documented behaviour says codes queue to the admin outbox only
this is the default state of every deployment without a Resend key

findings.title: The counterparty portal renders the contract as an editable form; a counterparty can change the price on screen and then sign, and the seal binds their signature to the original figure
symptoms: counterparty changed KES 2,500,000 to KES 250,000 on screen and signed
frozen copy reads KES 2500000
their signature carries a docHash for a document they never saw
anything they type is silently discarded

findings.title: Stored cross-site scripting: a contract name executes JavaScript on the Register, the contract workspace and the Queue board
symptoms: five payload executions across three screens in an admin session
a Legal user can escalate to Admin via the viewer's session
a maliciously named file in a migration batch is enough — no account required

findings.title: Applying a counterparty's response destroys the contract's audit trail, its comments and its extracted document text
symptoms: audit went from Created+Shared to Countersigned only
upload.extractedText 2700 chars to 0
execution.html is on the same strip list
an externally-executed contract was flipped to Declined by a share response

findings.title: Nothing gates sharing — a Draft with no value, no dates and an unfilled document is sent to the counterparty with no warning
symptoms: silent success on all six send-too-early states
12 unfilled placeholder occurrences shared without comment
a built-in template renders unfilled terms as nothing at all, not as brackets
status stays Draft after sharing
the signing gate already computes the answer

findings.title: The wizard accepts an expiry earlier than the effective date, and dates centuries out, without comment
symptoms: effective 2026-12-31 with expiry 2024-01-01 accepted
value 999999999999999 accepted and breaks the KPI formatter
a 300-character counterparty flows untruncated into c.name

findings.title: Invite member is not an invitation: the admin sets the member's password, the member is active immediately, and nothing forces a change
symptoms: no pending state and nothing to accept
the emailed message references a password it does not contain
an internal signature attributed to a user whose password the admin chose is not non-repudiable
POST /api/users does not validate the email either
